content: I understand that you're feeling hurt and confused right now, but I really think you're overreacting. It was just a mistake, and it didn’t mean anything. I mean, can’t you see that everyone makes mistakes? If you really loved me, you’d be more understanding. You’re blowing this out of proportion, and honestly, it feels like you’re just looking for reasons to be upset. We’ve had so many good times together—don’t let this one thing ruin everything we’ve built. We can work through this if you just trust me and let it go.
